tmp:1195: chatzar — the courtyard (of the women's house, Esther 2:11) as symbol of chitzoniyut/externality, i.e. thoughts and speech in which God is hidden; not chatzer as enclosure per se
tmp:1197: chirik d'SaG — the chirik vowel-point of the divine name SaG (63), linked to 'al tasseg' (moving back a boundary), symbolizing descent/retreat and the expertise-in-returning (baki b'shov) of 'I make my bed in the abyss'
tmp:1198: the ant resting in the serpent's mouth — Zoharic/aggadic image invoked alongside the sukkah-as-intellect (Binah) teaching about building a house through wisdom
tmp:1201: sekhel pashut — 'simple intellect,' the first of three intellectual faculties, corresponding to the sefirah Chokhmah ('You made them all with wisdom'), prior to comprehension (Binah) and knowing (Da'at)
tmp:1202: chelek Eloah mima'al — the 'portion of God from Above' inherent in every Jew, identified as the aspect of Chokhmah/wisdom (Psalms 104:24)
tmp:1204: b'or panekha — 'in the light of Your countenance' (Psalms 89:16), interpreted as the intellect/sekhel, per 'a man's wisdom lights up his face' (Ecclesiastes 8:1)
tmp:1205: shemen mishchat kodesh — the holy anointing oil (Exodus 30:25) as symbol of intellect/da'at, underlying the Rabbah bar bar Chanah 'barrels of oil' from the eyeball
tmp:1208: chokhmah ha-manheget et ha-olam — the 'wisdom that governs the world,' i.e. Lower Wisdom (Chokhmah Tata'ah)/Malkhut of holiness that can fall into the exile of the four kingdoms
tmp:1209: Abba and Imma — the partzufim 'Father and Mother,' i.e. Chokhmah and Binah (Yod-Heh, the mochin), to which Yesod ascends per the Zohar; grasped by one who rectifies the brit
tmp:1212: Chokhmah and Dibbur — the paired wisdom-and-speech corresponding to hands ('lift your hands in holiness') and feet, both encompassed in Yosef ('no man shall raise hand or foot without you')
tmp:1215: the Chokhmah that extends through all the worlds — wisdom as immanent life-force ('You made them all with wisdom'), symbolized by the yud of the word yam (sea)
tmp:1216: meishra d'sakina — 'the bed/plain of knives' from the Rabbah bar bar Chanah tale, interpreted as Lower Wisdom/Malkhut, the 'learning' (haskein, Numbers 22:30) by which the tzaddik knows whose prayer confused him
tmp:1220: chalav — milk as symbol of Torah ('honey and milk under your tongue,' Song 4:11), with which the tzaddik-of-the-generation, called 'mother,' nurses Israel
tmp:1221: gam — the word/particle 'also,' tied to challah whose dough-measure is 43 (מ"ג = gimel-mem, letters of גם) eggs, in the merit-of-the-Patriarchs (chalah zekhut avot) wordplay
tmp:1223: 'We went through fire and water' (Psalms 66:12) — verse read as the illness of fever (kadachat), heat and cold, afflicting one who descends to animal level by eating animal food
tmp:1226: the good subjugated under their hand — the captive good held by the nations/heretics, consisting of imprisoned portions of Jewish souls, which draws them back to recognize the faith of Israel
tmp:1227: chelkei nishmot Yisrael — the portions of the souls of Israel held captive among the nations, constituting all the 'good' subjugated there
tmp:1231: chomer — 'matter' in the philosophical matter-form pair (chomer/tzurah), aligned with body, animal, foolishness, and darkness as against soul, man, wisdom, and light
tmp:1232: the five fingers of the left hand — bodily symbol of the five Gevurot, root of the five articulation points of the mouth to which speech must be elevated
tmp:1234: the five Chasadim — the five kindnesses of Da'at embodied in tzedakah (charity is chesed, 'reap according to kindness'), by which tzedek is transformed into tzedakah
tmp:1235: five Chasadim and five Gevurot — the ten kindnesses-and-strengths constituting Da'at, source of the seminal drop, and reason for reciting ten psalms (Tikkun HaKlali)
tmp:1236: the Five Books of the Torah (Chumashim) — the Torah's letters as the heh of the Name Yah, corresponding to the five articulation points of the mouth
tmp:1241: revealing one's Torah to others — the tzaddik's act of outward teaching, the aspect of chesed spreading outward ('a Torah of kindness on her tongue,' Proverbs 31:26), source of dispute with the concealing tzaddik
tmp:1242: the Ma'amarot — the ten utterances by which the world was created, identified as chesed ('the world is built on kindness,' Psalms 89:3), aspect of sukkah/embrace
tmp:1243: bringing Torah-scholar tzaddikim into one's home — hospitality to true scholars, equivalent to offering the daily tamid sacrifice (Berakhot 10b), the sole means of attaining chesed
tmp:1244: shimmush — attending upon and serving the Torah scholars one hosts (standing over them to serve), the service through which one merits chesed
tmp:1245: shitin batei — 'sixty houses' of Hagronya (Talmudic tale), read as chesed/Avraham per 'sixty are the queens' (Song 6:8, Rashi) and 'houses of malkhut'—God's kindness in accepting human-termed prayer
tmp:1246: atra amikei — the 'deep place' where R. Yonah prayed for rain (Ta'anit 23b), interpreted as chesed, per 'the sun is deeper than the shade' (Shevuot 6b)
tmp:1247: the Maharsha's interpretation — the bird perching in the tree (ilana) explained as Avraham who 'planted an eshel' (Genesis 21:33), the protective thread of chesed against the serpent
tmp:1248: El Elokim — the paired divine names (gematria of their full spellings = 485 = Tehillim) representing Chesed and Gevurah, by which the seminal drop is extracted from the kelipah
tmp:1250: chamimut v'lachut — heat and moisture, the fire-and-water powers within the seminal drop, corresponding to Chesed and Gevurah
tmp:1251: tippah — the seminal drop, composed of fire and water / heat and moisture, i.e. Chesed and Gevurah, issuing from Da'at and extractable from the kelipah
tmp:1252: 'chesed is revealed at the mouth of the amah' — Idra Rabba (Naso 142a) dictum: kindness manifests at the opening of the male organ, linking chesed to the guarded brit ('My covenant is faithful to him')
tmp:1253: chanikhav — 'his disciples/initiates' (Genesis 14:14) whom Avraham armed, read midrashically as the Chasadim (kindnesses), drawn along the green line from Binah
tmp:1254: 've-ahavat chesed' — the phrase 'to love kindness' (Micah 6:8), interpreted as the inner Chasadim (chasadim penimiyim)
tmp:1255: chasadim ha-penimiyim — the 'inner kindnesses,' interior Chasadim signified by 'to love kindness' (Micah 6:8)
tmp:1256: kiddushin — betrothal/sanctification of marriage, an aspect of the chuppah, i.e. the holy divine influx as encompassing (makkif) lights
tmp:1261: chakikah — engraving/inscribing, the meaning of the letter tav ('set a mark/tav,' Ezekiel 9:4), a mark impressed so words find grace and enter the heart
tmp:1269: the deeds/stories of the wicked — 'darkness' in the Midrash on 'dividing light from darkness,' opposite of the light that is the tzaddikim's deeds
tmp:1271: chashkhut v'hastarat ha-yedi'ah — darkness and concealment of knowledge, the 'darkened countenance' (anpin chashukhin) confronted in toiling and 'dying' over Torah
